title: Novel insights into Pareto fronts in multiobjective topology optimization and a comparative study of scalarization strategies
summary: Topology optimization seeks structures that minimize an objective function subject to constraints. While extensive research has focused on single-objective formulations, design is usually a trade-off between conflicting criteria. This naturally leads topology optimization to the multiobjective optimization field. Unfortunately, despite their long coexistence, interaction between these fields has remained limited.
